name: audio_render
doc: One render of one frame (src/audio/ren.ts; nxnative render_once), made of calls into the SDK that the calling guest thread runs one after the other and that may block or be preempted in between. Queued: another thread's render is in progress (nxnative's g_render_mu: the two callers, render thread and catch-up, share the SDK's command buffer); it waits for the turn. Locking: the SDK's update lock is being taken (command generation must exclude the game's RequestUpdate). Generating: AudioRenderSystem::GenerateCommand. Unlocking: the update lock is given back. Processing: CommandListProcessor::Process, outside the lock; when it returns the host walks the command list and takes the DeviceSink's mix buffers.
